Name: Raccoon Family Expanded
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
What's that? MORE raccoon-related bundles? You got it bobo!

This mod adds a bundles-based storyline for the Raccoon's children after you complete the main Raccoon quest. It adds 30 bundles and 45 events to a new map - the Raccoon's Backyard. While the backyard starts off pretty sparse, watch it come to life bit by bit as you interact with the raccoon kits, complete bundles, and unlock their shops!

The entrance to the backyard appears right next to the raccoon's stump [b]after [/b]you've completed the main Raccoon quest. It starts off with just a few bundles, and more unlock over time. The raccoon kits [b]are not friendable NPCs[/b]; instead, you progress their storylines by completing their bundles, through which you help them explore their individual interests.

This mod can be added to preexisting saves, and completing its content is not required to achieve Perfection. If you install this mod mid-save, the NPCs may need a day to start following their schedules.

I've tried to balance bundles and rewards based on the assumption that you start the mod around halfway through the second year, with harder bundles helping you get access to a couple late-game items without being overpowered. Open to constructive criticism on that front!

There's a Mod Guide in the Articles tab of this mod page if you'd like more details about what all the mod adds and how to unlock things, but it should be pretty straightforward in-game without the guide.

[/size][/b][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/b]: compatible!
[*][b]Other expansions[/b] (RSV, ES, SBV, VMV etc): should be compatible, but let me know if you find any issues.

[/list]
[b][size=4]Translations[/size][/b]
No AI translations please. This mod is i18n-compatible! Translators, you can either send me a translation file to be included in the main mod files, or maintain your own separate mod translation. If you choose to have your own separate translation mod, please ensure it requires my mod to be downloaded (either as a dependency or as a file replacer), and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[size=4][b]Art Replacements
[/b][/size]No AI art please. If you'd like to make and publish your own version of any of the art I created for this mod, feel free! Just set my mod as a dependency and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[size=4][b]Bug Reports
[/b][/size]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please post them in the Bugs tab [b]with a link to your SMAPI log[/b]. Include a SMAPI log even if you don't see any errors in the SMAPI window. Instructions for generating a SMAPI log are here: [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log
[/url]
